scripts.setup:prod: cp -n .env.production.example .env.production 2>/dev/null || true; cp -n .env.cloudflared.example .env.cloudflared 2>/dev/null || true; cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: vite build && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun
scripts.docker:up:tunnel:
docker compose --profile default --profile tunnel -f docker-compose.yml -f - up -d <<'EOF'
services:
  jukebox:
    ports: !reset []
EOF
scripts.docker:build:registry: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; docker buildx build --platform "${JUKEBOX_PLATFORM:-linux/amd64}" -t "${JUKEBOX_IMAGE:?Set JUKEBOX_IMAGE in .env}" --load .'
scripts.docker:push: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; docker push "${JUKEBOX_IMAGE:?Set JUKEBOX_IMAGE in .env}"'
scripts.docker:publish: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t "${JUKEBOX_IMAGE:?Set JUKEBOX_IMAGE in .env}" --push .'
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --profile default --profile tunnel --profile mock down
scripts.docker:down:tunnel:
docker compose --profile default --profile tunnel -f docker-compose.yml -f - down <<'EOF'
services:
  jukebox:
    ports: !reset []
EOF
